reason: A web GUI interface enhancement that adds a selector for changing a session model's reasoning effort and a persistent visibility setting.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中添加推理程度选择器，用于切换会话模型的推理档位。
summaries.en: Adds a web GUI selector for switching the reasoning-effort level of the model used by a DeepSeek Harness session.

capabilities: Adds a reasoning-effort selector to the web GUI model menu
Reads available model and session state through host RPC services
Writes the selected reasoning effort to the active session model selection
Persists a local enable/disable setting in localStorage
